purpose: test again the three answer readouts that the 160-pair held-out set left unsupported or underpowered

items.status: new pairs, never scored; most templates were inspected through other pairs, so the items are new but the templates are not

conditions.P_span@1: matched-position erasure, rank-one frozen basis, alpha 1
conditions.CV_span@1: contrast vector at the term, energy matched per side to P_span@1 within 5 percent, no alpha cap

kernels: bfloat16, flash attention 2.8.3, torch 2.5.1, transformers 5.17.0 (as the rebuttal cycle)

readouts.T: total variation between the two versions' option distributions, summed option log-likelihood
readouts.T_mean: the same with mean log-likelihood per token
readouts.flip: 1 when both generated answers are valid and select different options, 0 when valid and equal; pairs with an invalid side are dropped

primary_family.statistic: per template, the mean over the four models of the per-template mean of B minus P_span@1; one-sided (greater), studentised bootstrap over templates, 10,000 resamples

secondary_families.per_model_erasure: per readout, B minus P_span@1 for each model, one-sided (greater), Holm over the four models
secondary_families.per_model_vector: per readout, B minus CV_span@1 for each model, one-sided (greater), Holm over the four models
secondary_families.erasure_vs_vector: per readout, P_span@1 minus CV_span@1 for each model, two-sided, descriptive

combined_with_inspected_set: reported separately as exploratory, never as the confirmatory result
outcome_rules: supported when the test rejects in the stated direction after Holm; a rejection in the opposite direction is reported as a supported reversal; otherwise limited. Every number is reported whichever way it falls.
expected_power_note: From the 160-pair noise split at about 11 pairs per template over 82 templates: the T fall is well powered on Llama-3.1-8B and Phi-4-mini, weakly on Gemma-2-2B, not on Qwen2.5-7B; T_mean is expected to show reversals on Llama-3.1-8B and Gemma-2-2B; the flip test is adequately powered only on Qwen2.5-7B. The pooled tests are the primary family for that reason.
smoke: two new pairs plus two inspected pairs per model; the inspected pairs must reproduce their stored B and P_span@1 option scores
